name: Belgrade
tagline: Fortress views and Europe's liveliest nightlife
summary: Belgrade, Serbia's energetic capital, sits where the Sava meets the Danube. Watch sunset from Kalemegdan Fortress, stroll Knez Mihailova and bohemian Skadarlija, visit the vast Church of Saint Sava and Tito's mausoleum, and party on the floating river clubs.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summer is hot with river clubs at full swing.
arrival: Nikola Tesla Airport is 25 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; buses, trams and CarGo taxis.
cashTip: Prices are shown in euros; locally you pay in Serbian dinars (RSD), about 117 to the euro. Cards work in most places; carry dinars for kafanas, markets and taxis.

connections.note: New fast line via Novi Sad.
